_doc: CA CCRC muni obligor universe — California Continuing Care Retirement Communities (Life Plan Communities) with outstanding muni bonds issued through CA conduits (CHFFA, CSCDA, CMFA, City of Alhambra). Excludes pure hospital systems, pure assisted-living/memory-care chains, single-tier nursing homes, and CCRCs without muni bonds (e.g., Vi/Hyatt private). Sources: CSCDA press releases, CHFFA meeting docs, EMMA bond filings (CUSIPs noted), Ziegler closings, operator IR pages, Fitch rating actions. Many CCRC bond ratings have shifted to private/non-published; LOW confidence indicates rating unverified at as-of date.
scope_notes: Type A = Life Care (all-inclusive); Type B = Modified; Type C = Fee-for-Service. Most CA nonprofit LPCs offer Type A or mixed contracts. SNF beds tracked separately from RCFE units. Vi at Palo Alto / Vi at La Jolla (Classic Residence) are privately financed and excluded. Brookdale and Atria rental properties excluded. Sunrise / Pacifica Senior Living excluded (rental-only, Pacifica filed Ch 7 in March 2025).

historical_ca_ccrc_defaults_and_distress.name: Air Force Village West / Altavita Village
historical_ca_ccrc_defaults_and_distress.outcome: Default + receivership; sold for $58M to Westmont Living (LP affiliate) in 2019; CCRC contracts discontinued, converted to rental
historical_ca_ccrc_defaults_and_distress.notes: Overbuilt and undermarketed; occupancy fell to ~50%; bondholders forced into receivership; managed by Eskaton during turnaround; ultimately sold and de-CCRC'd. Notable CA-specific cautionary tale for new-development CCRC bonds.

ca_conduit_issuer_notes.CHFFA: California Health Facilities Financing Authority. AB 839 (chaptered Oct 2023, effective Jan 1 2024) expanded CHFFA eligibility to standalone RCFEs and IL/AL/memory care, opening CCRC financing access. ECS was first issuer under new auth.
ca_conduit_issuer_notes.CSCDA: California Statewide Communities Development Authority. Dominant CCRC conduit historically. Bonds are limited obligations of borrower.
ca_conduit_issuer_notes.CMFA: California Municipal Finance Authority. Active conduit for mid-size CCRC deals (Carmel Valley Manor, Aldersly, Paradise Valley Estates, Redwood Terrace/Westminster).
ca_conduit_issuer_notes.City_of_Alhambra: Historical issuer for Atherton Baptist Homes (insured revenue refunding series).

rating_tier_breakdown.investment_grade_A_to_A_minus: HumanGood CA OG (A, Fitch), Front Porch (A-, Fitch+S&P), Sequoia Living (AA- enhanced via Cal-Mortgage), ECS (A-, Fitch). All HumanGood and Front Porch sub-communities roll up to these ratings.
rating_tier_breakdown.investment_grade_BBB: None publicly identified in CA standalone universe (most BBB-tier CCRCs nationally are out-of-state)
rating_tier_breakdown.unrated_private_placement: Mt. San Antonio Gardens, Channing House, Carmel Valley Manor, Casa Dorinda, Paradise Valley Estates, Aldersly, Atherton Baptist Homes, Pilgrim Place, The Forum at Rancho San Antonio, URC Davis, St. Paul's Senior Services, O'Connor Woods, Rowntree Gardens, Friends House (~14 obligors)

summary_stats.structural_observations: Most CA CCRC muni debt is concentrated in 4 obligated groups (HumanGood CA, Front Porch, Sequoia Living, ECS) which collectively control 25+ communities. Standalone single-site issuers (Channing House, Mt. San Antonio Gardens, Aldersly, Carmel Valley Manor, Atherton, Pilgrim Place, Casa Dorinda) tend to be smaller, unrated/private, and rely on Ziegler-arranged Cal-Mortgage-insured deals.
